arguments.body:
Hi Petra,

Confirming the revised GH-7 wellhead crane lift plan with Northstar Crane. Please review the operational details below:

- Date: Thursday, 18 September 2026
- Equipment: 70-ton crane
- Vendor check-in: 07:15 (Asia/Tokyo)
- Lift window: 08:00 – 10:00 (Asia/Tokyo)
- Access point: Gate 4
- Work area: Laydown Zone C
- Assigned signalperson: Demba Nouri

A coordination hold has been placed on the calendar for the lift window. Please confirm your team's readiness and let us know if any adjustments are needed before the check-in time.

Thank you,
Belen Marcoux
